title: Defy the Heavens
status: Five original promotional metaphors of active cultivator defiance

One hand grips a battered straight sword raised high to meet a single enormous white-violet lightning column, the other clenched at his side. Show the exact impact ABOVE his raised blade: lightning branches shatter into luminous shards around the sword tip while his boots remain grounded in cracking rock. He is not a cosmic giant; the towering storm must dwarf him. Strong motion diagonals, distant mountain spires bending through rain, white heat against deep cobalt and violet. Sparks and torn robe edges imply cost without gore. LEFT holds a dark storm pocket for title; leave separation between title and lightning. The viewer feels: Heaven may strike, but he will not kneel.
